title: panel-demos — a Demo tab on the Panel page: a walk-through of the UX, each demo a flow beside a follow-along

set.request: add a new Panel page tab (demo). use the classdoc style inner left nav for each demo. for each demo, add a starting panel, and a description of what to do. create a series of demos that walks us through exactly how this thing works. demos are not about the code, more about the UX. make a note in the Panel readme to demo all features. adapt the panel flow feature for demos: a split screen — left side is the prebuilt panel-flow demo, the guide, and the right side is just the starting point, the workspace, the follow-along portion.
set.now: waiting on task A (workspace-a-sizing) to land, reading flow.js/workspace.js/toolbar.js/glyphs.js meanwhile
steps: Wait for task A to land; read flow.js, workspace.js, Doc.js, tabs.js, toolbar.js, glyphs.js, size.js
demo/page.js — inner left nav, 12 demo entries, split view
Record the 12 flows headless with Playwright into demo/flows/*.json
page.js — one-line children edit (after A lands)
Prove headless: zero console errors, N/N steps, left/right independence; two pngs

links.label: demo 7 — wraps to two full-width rows at 1280

set.outcome:
**Wrap, not force — the third pass.** Replaced `.flex.gap` on the demo row with `.flex.gap.auto` plus `--column: 24em`, dropped the `flex-1`/min-width hacks on the two panes (framework.css's `.flex.auto > *` rule already gives each child `flex: var(--grow,1) 1 calc(var(--column) * var(--grow,1)); min-width: 0`), kept `bleed`.

**Proven headless, zero console errors throughout:**
- **1280** — two rows (guide over follow-along), each pane **461.7px** wide (target: ≥440px).
- **1920** — one row (side by side), each pane **436px** wide — narrower than at 1280 despite the bigger viewport, because the app's own sidebar and this tab's inner nav rail both scale with viewport too (clamp()-based gutters, an 18%-wide rail), eating more of the extra space than the row gets. Still one row as asked, reported as measured rather than assumed.

Re-shot `demo-7-document-mode.png` and `demo-1-flex-scratch.png` at 1280, both now show a real bordered pane on top and bottom, no width games.
